_doc: Halcyra, the post-game Era IV (Panorama) region (scripts/core/Region4.gd, tests/unit/test_region4.gd). A sunlit high plateau of terraces, white stone and golden roofs, cut by cliffs, stairs and bridges. It opens with the flag in unlock_flag, which is the Era III finale flag of data/eras.json: Era III's own region sets it when its last chapter is done (eras.json finale_flags), so Halcyra chains after Era III without code changes. Its last chapter sets finale_flag, which eras.json turns into era4_finale_done (Era V). Drawn in Era IV: 270x480, 96px sprites, the 2.5D battle stage, tiles in art/era4/tiles/overworld_halcyra.png (tools/art/gen_tiles_halcyra.py, colours in data/region_looks.json). Maps: tools/art/world/halcyra.py builds every town, route, Rift and the Great Orrery from this sheet (pos = cell in world_layout.json region halcyra; route slots = data/encounters.json tables, weights in the stand-in's rarity band). The way in is the Gilt Funicular (world_layout.json line halcyra_funicular) from the Greyreach, running once unlock_flag is set; Era III's last town can add itself as a stop. Encounter slots with species null wait for Halcyra's own Spirlings; until then stand_in names an existing Spirling. Landmarks span several screens (design plan 309). Elements: Halcyra's own new types Gilt and Zenith (Era IV in data/type_chart.json); they enter the Elements enum with Halcyra's Spirlings. Rings 78 to 96 (Spirlings have no top ring; Spirling.STORY_RING 60 is the story's last); the wild tables climb at most 4 rings past the table before within an era (WorldValidator.MAX_RING_JUMP). Rift flags are rift_<warden key>_sealed (GameState.seal_rift with the npc's warden key v4_<rift>); chapters 2 to 4 end when their Rift is sealed, chapter 5 when the feast host in Gildcrest is heard out.
name: Halcyra

arrival.text: The funicular climbs for an hour. Halfway up, the brakeman asks if you have written a will. He is not joking. He sells the paper.

towns.name: Brightledge
towns.text: The top station. The view is free, the bench costs extra and the railing is a rumour.

towns.name: Gildcrest
towns.text: Golden roofs, white walls and a family that owns both. Smile, the windows are watching.

towns.name: Starwell
towns.text: An observatory town. They read the stars here and sell what they read to the highest bidder.

towns.name: Paleshore
towns.text: A town on a dried lake that still reflects the sky. And everyone who walks on it.

towns.name: Whitecairn
towns.text: The last town before the edge. The cairns are graves of people who said no to the Gilt House.

landmarks.name: The Great Orrery
landmarks.text: Brass planets the size of houses turn over the town. One of them is missing. Nobody admits to having it.

landmarks.name: The Gilt Span
landmarks.text: A bridge over nothing at all, lit by lanterns paid for by the families of those who fell.

landmarks.name: The White Stair
landmarks.text: Nine hundred steps of white stone. The Gilt House counts them every morning, in case one went missing.

wardens.name: Warden Isaura
wardens.intro: I read your stars this morning. They said you lose. I charged them for the reading.
wardens.defeat: The stars were wrong. Do not tell my customers. I have refunds to avoid.

wardens.name: Warden Halloran
wardens.intro: Every grain of salt on these flats is mine. You are standing on my money. Wipe your feet.
wardens.defeat: Fine. Take the Rift. The salt stays. So do the people buried under it.

wardens.name: Warden Veronne
wardens.intro: I collect the toll on the Span. Cash, Spirlings or a little push. Your choice.
wardens.defeat: You crossed. Lovely. The toll for coming back is double, and I keep the bridge.

wardens.name: Warden Aurek
wardens.intro: My family built every roof you admired on the way up. Gold on top, bones in the walls. Welcome home.
wardens.defeat: Take the Rift. My children will take the house from me by dinner anyway. They learned from the best.

story.title: Chapter 1: The Long Way Up
story.text: Fixer Oriel Vane waits at the top station with tea and a contract. The Gilt House wants the four Rifts sealed before the summer feast.

betrayal.text: The funicular stopped halfway on purpose. The brakeman counted your team and sent the list ahead, one copy per family.

story.title: Chapter 2: Written in the Stars
story.text: The Great Orrery has lost a planet and the town has lost its nerve. Isaura keeps the Orrery Rift and every secret worth a coin.

betrayal.text: Isaura sold your horoscope to the Gilt House: route, weak spots and the day you would arrive. All of it came true.

story.title: Chapter 3: Salt in the Wound
story.text: The flats mirror the sky so well that people walk off the edge. Halloran calls it erosion. The widows call it rent.

betrayal.text: Your fixer Oriel has worked for Halloran all along. The tea was weak on purpose, so you would sleep through the ambush.

story.title: Chapter 4: Toll
story.text: Every lantern on the Gilt Span is a debt. Veronne offers you a deal at the middle of the bridge, where nobody can hear you scream.

betrayal.text: Halloran cuts Oriel loose to buy his own way out. She turns up at Whitecairn with a cairn stone and an apology. Only one of them is heavy.

story.title: Chapter 5: Gold on Top
story.text: The summer feast begins under golden roofs. Aurek raises a glass to the Wayfarer who did his dirty work.

betrayal.text: Aurek's own children poisoned the feast to take the house. You were the alibi. Trust no one, least of all a family that says you are one of them.
